luna_art_direction.art_direction_ar: تنفيذ جرافيكي محلي بالكامل: حجر مبلل، كلمتان عربيتان، ومسار ضوئي يفتح داخل كلمة «السقوط» دون محوها.

cinematic_blueprint.action: Create a 13-second local 2.5D conceptual graphic. Begin with the Arabic word «السقوط» engraved or painted on a wet dark stone. A narrow controlled light seam travels through the existing word and opens a path toward the Arabic word «التوبة», while «السقوط» remains visibly present and is never erased. End with both words legible and connected by the opening.
cinematic_blueprint.atmosphere: Minimal, solemn, tactile, contemplative, and symbolic; no literal religious figure or supernatural entity.
cinematic_blueprint.camera: Designed full-frame 2.5D composition with a restrained fixed perspective and subtle depth parallax between foreground stone, typography plane, and background darkness. No template zoom, no simulated handheld movement, no camera orbit.
cinematic_blueprint.color_palette: Charcoal black stone, restrained white highlights, antique gold light, and warm parchment accents; controlled contrast and no saturated fantasy colors.
cinematic_blueprint.composition: One centered typographic concept: «السقوط» begins slightly lower and left of center, the light seam opens through it toward «التوبة» slightly higher and right, maintaining right-to-left series continuity while preserving generous negative space.
cinematic_blueprint.continuity: Match SEQ-14 palette ID CHARCOAL_ANTIQUE_GOLD_WARM_PARCHMENT_SYMBOLIC, frame-right light direction, scale language, silhouette restraint, and right-to-left visual progression. This is a local graphic, not generated footage.
cinematic_blueprint.environment: A dark wet stone surface presented as a conceptual editorial plate, with no literal heavenly geography, characters, creatures, or unseen embodiment.
cinematic_blueprint.lens: Not applicable to local graphics; use a designed 2.5D perspective with a restrained virtual depth hierarchy rather than photographic lens simulation.
cinematic_blueprint.lighting: Animate a thin antique-gold-white light seam from frame right across the stone; preserve black and white structure, with a soft reflected glow in the wet surface and no flare bloom.
cinematic_blueprint.materials: Wet charcoal stone, shallow engraved or painted Arabic lettering, controlled specular reflections, matte darkness, and clean compositing layers.
cinematic_blueprint.safety: Conceptual typography only. Do not depict Allah, prophets, angels, Iblis, unseen beings, faces, bodies, creatures, sacred scenes, or literal supernatural events. Arabic text must be manually typeset and remain exact, stable, readable, and free of generated pseudo-lettering, logos, watermarks, subtitles, or decorative illegibility.
cinematic_blueprint.subject: The relationship between the exact words «السقوط» and «التوبة», expressed through an opening path of light rather than deletion or transformation of the first word.
cinematic_blueprint.temporal_motion: 0–3s: reveal wet stone and stable «السقوط». 3–8s: light seam slowly opens through the word without erasing it. 8–11s: the seam extends toward «التوبة», which resolves cleanly. 11–13s: hold both words and the connecting path with only subtle reflected-light movement.
